import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    g = params[0]*np.exp(-params[1]*t) + params[2]*np.exp(-params[3]*t) + params[4] + params[7]*t
    h = -params[5]*t/(t + params[6])
    return g + h*A**2
